Leave your bag at your desk.
Line up at the door.
Walk down the stairs with your class.

passages.title: SkyDart Rocket Kit

visual.title: SkyDart Rocket Kit
visual.note: Ask an adult to help you launch your rocket.
rows: Glue the three fins onto the tube.
Wait one hour for the glue to dry.
Push the nose cone onto the top of the tube.
Put the star stickers on the tube.
Launch your rocket at the park with an adult.

passages.title: Pumping Up a Bike Tire
sentences: Sam's back bike tire feels soft, so he takes his bike to Okafor's Bike Shop.
Mr. Okafor shows him how to pump up the tire by himself.
"First, take the small cap off the valve," says Mr. Okafor.
"Put the cap in your pocket so you can keep it safe."
Next, Sam carefully pushes the end of the pump onto the valve.
He flips the little lever up to lock the pump in place.
Then he pumps until the needle on the pressure gauge points to 50.
"Now flip the lever down and pull the pump off," says Mr. Okafor.
Last, Sam screws the cap back onto the valve.
He squeezes the tire with his hand, and now it feels firm and full.
"Now you can do this at home with your own pump," says Mr. Okafor with a smile.

steps.say: I need to put the steps in order. I look for order words like first, then and last.
This step starts with First. The banana and berries go in first.
This step starts with Then. The milk goes in next.
This step starts with Last. The lid goes on and they press START at the end.
So the order is fruit, then milk, then the lid and START.
